any2track-v2.text: This track uses lvhaidong/LAFAN1_Retargeting_Dataset, while the author checkpoint uses LocoMuJoCo-retargeted LAFAN1. The motion names overlap, but the robot trajectories are not identical.

Shared canonical physics differs from the author setup, including contact geometry, joint damping and friction. The current score measures this benchmark configuration; it does not reproduce the author-reported 40/40.

The low success rate is being investigated. Existing randomized observation and motor-target comparisons do not cover the complete reset and closed-loop pipeline; they cannot rule out an adapter error.
